name: Jaguar's Protection
body:
Jaguar's Protection (Ex)
Source Heroes of Golarion pg. 4
When a slayer with this talent deals sneak attack damage, he draws the target’s attention away from his allies. The affected enemy takes a –2 penalty on attack rolls made against anyone other than the slayer for 1 minute. The slayer must have the jaguar’s pounce talent to select this talent.
